     - The test cases validate that different users (read-only, view users, administrators) exhibit the expected authorization behavior when attempting to access VIEW resources.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in `AuthorizationHelper.java` directly affect how user roles are validated against VIEW resources. The removal of the unconditional access allows for more fine-grained control over which users can access VIEW resources based on their assigned roles and privileges. 

Simultaneously, the changes in `AuthorizationHelperTest.java` ensure that the new authorization rules are correctly implemented and enforced by adding comprehensive unit tests. This ensures that the updated logic in `AuthorizationHelper.java` is functioning as intended and adheres to the requirements of the RBAC system. The tests check various scenarios, confirming that only authorized users can access specific VIEW instances, thus maintaining the integrity of the access control mechanism.
